text_markup: The Runner plays {card:Ritual} while they have 3 [click] remaining and an installed copy of {card:The Class Act}. {card:Ritual}'s instruction will have the Runner perform 1 instance of drawing 3 cards, so {card:The Class Act}'s interrupt ability will first have the Runner look at the top 4 cards of their stack and add 1 to the bottom.
text_plain: The Runner plays Ritual while they have 3 {click} remaining and an installed copy of The Class Act. Ritual's instruction will have the Runner perform 1 instance of drawing 3 cards, so The Class Act's interrupt ability will first have the Runner look at the top 4 cards of their stack and add 1 to the bottom.
